citations.assessment: The Bavli explicitly names Avdimi bar Hammodari in the dispute on mats and coverings.
The Bavli names Mar bar Hammodari as the reporter in Shmuel’s name and then quotes Rava citing bar Hammodari. This does not settle whether they are the same person.
The Bavli gives bar Hammodari reporting Shmuel and explaining the ruling to Rava, matching a notice in the paired entry.
The named bar Hammodari gives Shmuel’s teaching on the remaining length of the threads.
This comparison supplies Rava’s citation of bar Hammodari in the other Heilprin cross-reference.
This is the exact related entry. It carries parallel reports in Shmuel’s name and leaves some identities open.
The Avdimi entry identifies the two interpreters of his teaching in Sukkah.
The Mar entry records Heilprin’s doubt about whether Mar is a personal name here.

holds.reason: Mar’s name and identity remain qualified.
